items.docs: You only need to initialize EdgeKV once. This operation adds the `default` EdgeKV namespace to Akamai's `STAGING` and `PRODUCTION` networks. It also creates a new dedicated CP code for you to track your EdgeKV usage. You won't be able to use any of the EdgeKV API operations or your EdgeKV database until initialization completes.
